definition: to go backwards away from something
description: Sea kayaking in front of a glacier under a grey sky. A young man in a red helmet, a yellow jacket and a life vest faces the camera and paddles hard away from the glacier in a white sea kayak, his face strained, as a huge wall of blue ice breaks off behind him and crashes into the sea in a cloud of spray. Other kayakers in bright jackets sit in their kayaks further back, chunks of ice float on the choppy grey sea around him and seabirds circle overhead.
